title: Integrating Wildfire Risk into Robust Forest Management Optimization
summary: Increasingly severe and unpredictable extreme weather events-such as high-intensity forest firesthreaten long-term ecosystem service provision, driving a critical reassessment of current forest management planning. While planning frameworks exist, few incorporate optimization methods that account for the uncertainty and variability introduced by such extremes. Meanwhile, process-based models have advanced our understanding of fire impacts on forest dynamics and ecosystem services, yet their potential to inform strategic management decisions remains largely untapped.
